articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist USDⓈ-M Multiple Perpetual Contracts (2026-04-28)
articles.body_text: This is a general Binance Exchange Notice. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, At Binance Futures, the team periodically reviews each futures contract based on a variety of factors. The team considers the following factors when determining whether a futures contract will be delisted: Trading volume and liquidity Stability and safety of network from attacks New regulatory requirements Change in token supply, tokenomics, project’s ownership structure, commitment of team to project and project’s development activity Responsiveness to our periodic due diligence requests Evidence of unethical/fraudulent conduct or negligence Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on USDⓈ-M VINEUSDT and AIUSDT Perpetual Contracts at 2026-04-28 10:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  This information is released as a Notice under Binance Exchange Rule 17. Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new orders for the aforementioned contract(s) starting from 2026-04-28 09:30 (UTC) . During the final hour proceeding the scheduled settlement time of a futures contract, the Futures Insurance Fund will not be utilised to support the liquidation process in respect of that futures contract. Any such liquidation triggered during the final hour will be executed as a single Immediate or Cancel order (“IOCO”), which will be offloaded into the market in one attempt. If, following the execution of the IOCO, the assets remaining available in the user's account are sufficient to meet the required Maintenance Margin (after accounting for realized losses and any applicable Liquidation Clearance Fee), the liquidation will cease. If the IOCO fails to fully reduce the position to a level that satisfies the Margin Maintenance requirements, any unfilled portion of the position will be resolved through the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) process. Users are strongly advised to actively monitor and manage open positions during the final hour, as this period may be subject to heightened volatility and reduced liquidity. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contract(s) without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: Delisting of Futures Contract USDⓈ-M Futures Trading Parameters Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contract Mark Price and Price Index Binance Futures Contract Specification   Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-04-24

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist USDⓈ-M Multiple Perpetual Contracts (2026-04-28 & 2026-04-29)
articles.body_text: This is a general Binance Exchange Notice. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, At Binance Futures, the team periodically reviews each futures contract based on a variety of factors. The team considers the following factors when determining whether a futures contract will be delisted: Trading volume and liquidity Stability and safety of network from attacks New regulatory requirements Change in token supply, tokenomics, project’s ownership structure, commitment of team to project and project’s development activity Responsiveness to our periodic due diligence requests Evidence of unethical/fraudulent conduct or negligence Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement the following perpetual contract(s) as below: 2026-04-28 09:00 (UTC) : USDⓈ-M B3USDT, DEGENUSDT and BOBUSDT Perpetual Contracts 2026-04-29 09:00 (UTC) : USDⓈ-M ZKJUSDT, IRUSDT and DAMUSDT Perpetual Contracts The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  This information is released as a Notice under Binance Exchange Rule 17. Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new non-reduce only orders for the aforementioned contract(s) as below: 2026-04-28 08:30 (UTC) : USDⓈ-M B3USDT, DEGENUSDT and BOBUSDT Perpetual Contracts 2026-04-29 08:30 (UTC) : USDⓈ-M ZKJUSDT, IRUSDT and DAMUSDT Perpetual Contracts During the final hour proceeding the scheduled settlement time of a futures contract, the Futures Insurance Fund will not be utilised to support the liquidation process in respect of that futures contract. Any such liquidation triggered during the final hour will be executed as a single Immediate or Cancel order (“IOCO”), which will be offloaded into the market in one attempt. If, following the execution of the IOCO, the assets remaining available in the user's account are sufficient to meet the required Maintenance Margin (after accounting for realized losses and any applicable Liquidation Clearance Fee), the liquidation will cease. If the IOCO fails to fully reduce the position to a level that satisfies the Margin Maintenance requirements, any unfilled portion of the position will be resolved through the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) process. Users are strongly advised to actively monitor and manage open positions during the final hour, as this period may be subject to heightened volatility and reduced liquidity. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contract(s) without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: Delisting of Futures Contract USDⓈ-M Futures Trading Parameters Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contract Mark Price and Price Index Binance Futures Contract Specification   Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-04-23

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist Multiple Perpetual Contracts (2026-04-08 & 2026-04-09)
articles.body_text: This is a general Binance Exchange Notice. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement the following perpetual contract(s) as below: 2026-04-08 09:00 (UTC) : USDⓈ-M OLUSDT, HIPPOUSDT, RLSUSDT and PUFFERUSDT Perpetual Contracts 2026-04-09 09:00 (UTC) : COIN-M WIFUSD and WLDUSD Perpetual Contracts The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  This information is released as a Notice under Binance Exchange Rule 17. Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new non-reduce only orders for the aforementioned contract(s) as below: 2026-04-08 08:30 (UTC) : USDⓈ-M OLUSDT, HIPPOUSDT, RLSUSDT and PUFFERUSDT Perpetual Contracts 2026-04-09 08:30 (UTC) : COIN-M WIFUSD and WLDUSD Perpetual Contracts During the final hour proceeding the scheduled settlement time of a futures contract, the Futures Insurance Fund will not be utilised to support the liquidation process in respect of that futures contract. Any such liquidation triggered during the final hour will be executed as a single Immediate or Cancel order (“IOCO”), which will be offloaded into the market in one attempt. If, following the execution of the IOCO, the assets remaining available in the user's account are sufficient to meet the required Maintenance Margin (after accounting for realized losses and any applicable Liquidation Clearance Fee), the liquidation will cease. If the IOCO fails to fully reduce the position to a level that satisfies the Margin Maintenance requirements, any unfilled portion of the position will be resolved through the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) process. Users are strongly advised to actively monitor and manage open positions during the final hour, as this period may be subject to heightened volatility and reduced liquidity. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contract(s) without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: Delisting of Futures contract Trading Rules to Trading Parameter Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Mark Price and Price Index Binance Futures Contract Specification   Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-04-03

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist Multiple USDⓈ-M and COIN-M Perpetual Contracts (2026-03-17 & 2026-03-18)
articles.body_text: This is a general Binance Exchange Notice. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement the following perpetual contract(s) as below: 2026-03-17 09:00 (UTC) : USDⓈ-M VFYUSDT, 1000WHYUSDT and BDXNUSDT Perpetual Contracts 2026-03-18 09:00 (UTC) : COIN-M ALGOUSD, SANDUSD, ENSUSD and ATOMUSD Perpetual Contracts The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  This information is released as a Notice under Binance Exchange Rule 17. Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new non-reduce only orders for the aforementioned contract(s) as below: 2026-03-17 08:30 (UTC) : USDⓈ-M VFYUSDT, 1000WHYUSDT and BDXNUSDT Perpetual Contracts 2026-03-18 08:30 (UTC) : COIN-M ALGOUSD, SANDUSD, ENSUSD and ATOMUSD Perpetual Contracts During the final hour proceeding the scheduled settlement time of a futures contract, the Futures Insurance Fund will not be utilised to support the liquidation process in respect of that futures contract. Any such liquidation triggered during the final hour will be executed as a single Immediate or Cancel order (“IOCO”), which will be offloaded into the market in one attempt. If, following the execution of the IOCO, the assets remaining available in the user's account are sufficient to meet the required Maintenance Margin (after accounting for realized losses and any applicable Liquidation Clearance Fee), the liquidation will cease. If the IOCO fails to fully reduce the position to a level that satisfies the Margin Maintenance requirements, any unfilled portion of the position will be resolved through the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) process. Users are strongly advised to actively monitor and manage open positions during the final hour, as this period may be subject to heightened volatility and reduced liquidity. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contract(s) without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: Delisting of Futures contract Trading Rules to Trading Parameter Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Mark Price and Price Index Binance Futures Contract Specification   Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-03-13

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist Multiple USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts (2026-01-30)
articles.body_text: This is a general Binance Exchange Notice. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on USDⓈ-M 42USDT, COMMONUSDT , CUDISUSDT and EPTUSDT Perpetual Contracts at 2026-01-30 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  This information is released as a Notice under Binance Exchange Rule 17. Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to place new orders for the aforementioned contract(s) starting from 2026-01-30 08:30 (UTC) . During the final hour proceeding the scheduled settlement time of a futures contract, the Futures Insurance Fund will not be utilised to support the liquidation process in respect of that futures contract. Any such liquidation triggered during the final hour will be executed as a single Immediate or Cancel order (“IOCO”), which will be offloaded into the market in one attempt. If, following the execution of the IOCO, the assets remaining available in the user's account are sufficient to meet the required Maintenance Margin (after accounting for realized losses and any applicable Liquidation Clearance Fee), the liquidation will cease. If the IOCO fails to fully reduce the position to a level that satisfies the Margin Maintenance requirements, any unfilled portion of the position will be resolved through the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) process. Users are strongly advised to actively monitor and manage open positions during the final hour, as this period may be subject to heightened volatility and reduced liquidity. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contract(s) without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: Delisting of Futures contract Trading Rules to Trading Parameter Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Mark Price and Price Index Binance Futures Contract Specification   Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-01-28

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist AIAUSDT USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract (2025-12-11)
articles.body_text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on USDⓈ-M AIAUSDT Perpetual Contract at 2025-12-11 12:15 (UTC) . The contract will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract(s) starting from 2025-12-11 11:45 (UTC) . During the final hour proceeding the scheduled settlement time of a futures contract, the Futures Insurance Fund will not be utilised to support the liquidation process in respect of that futures contract. Any such liquidation triggered during the final hour will be executed as a single Immediate or Cancel order (“IOCO”), which will be offloaded into the market in one attempt. If, following the execution of the IOCO, the assets remaining available in the user's account are sufficient to meet the required Maintenance Margin (after accounting for realized losses and any applicable Liquidation Clearance Fee), the liquidation will cease. If the IOCO fails to fully reduce the position to a level that satisfies the Margin Maintenance requirements, any unfilled portion of the position will be resolved through the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) process. Users are strongly advised to actively monitor and manage open positions during the final hour, as this period may be subject to heightened volatility and reduced liquidity. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contract(s) without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: Delisting of Futures contract Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Mark Price and Price Index Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-12-11

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist Multiple USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts (2025-12-10)
articles.body_text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on USDⓈ-M SKATEUSDT, REIUSDT , FISUSDT and VOXELUSDT Perpetual Contracts at 2025-12-10 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract(s) starting from 2025-12-10 08:30 (UTC) . During the final hour proceeding the scheduled settlement time of a futures contract, the Futures Insurance Fund will not be utilised to support the liquidation process in respect of that futures contract. Any such liquidation triggered during the final hour will be executed as a single Immediate or Cancel order (“IOCO”), which will be offloaded into the market in one attempt. If, following the execution of the IOCO, the assets remaining available in the user's account are sufficient to meet the required Maintenance Margin (after accounting for realized losses and any applicable Liquidation Clearance Fee), the liquidation will cease. If the IOCO fails to fully reduce the position to a level that satisfies the Margin Maintenance requirements, any unfilled portion of the position will be resolved through the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) process. Users are strongly advised to actively monitor and manage open positions during the final hour, as this period may be subject to heightened volatility and reduced liquidity. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contract(s) without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: Delisting of Futures contract Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Mark Price and Price Index Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-12-05

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist Multiple USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts (2025-11-28)
articles.body_text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on USDⓈ-M PONKEUSDT , SWELLUSDT , and QUICKUSDT Perpetual Contracts at 2025-11-28 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract(s) starting from 2025-11-28 08:30 (UTC) . During the final hour proceeding the scheduled settlement time of a futures contract, the Futures Insurance Fund will not be utilised to support the liquidation process in respect of that futures contract. Any such liquidation triggered during the final hour will be executed as a single Immediate or Cancel order (“IOCO”), which will be offloaded into the market in one attempt. If, following the execution of the IOCO, the assets remaining available in the user's account are sufficient to meet the required Maintenance Margin (after accounting for realized losses and any applicable Liquidation Clearance Fee), the liquidation will cease. If the IOCO fails to fully reduce the position to a level that satisfies the Margin Maintenance requirements, any unfilled portion of the position will be resolved through the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) process. Users are strongly advised to actively monitor and manage open positions during the final hour, as this period may be subject to heightened volatility and reduced liquidity. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contract(s) without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: Delisting of Futures contract Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Mark Price and Price Index Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-11-24

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist Multiple USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts (2025-11-21)
articles.body_text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on USDⓈ-M XCNUSDT , FLMUSDT and PERPUSDT Perpetual Contracts at 2025-11-21 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract(s) starting from 2025-11-21 08:30 (UTC) . During the final hour proceeding the scheduled settlement time of a futures contract, the Futures Insurance Fund will not be utilised to support the liquidation process in respect of that futures contract. Any such liquidation triggered during the final hour will be executed as a single Immediate or Cancel order (“IOCO”), which will be offloaded into the market in one attempt. If, following the execution of the IOCO, the assets remaining available in the user's account are sufficient to meet the required Maintenance Margin (after accounting for realized losses and any applicable Liquidation Clearance Fee), the liquidation will cease. If the IOCO fails to fully reduce the position to a level that satisfies the Margin Maintenance requirements, any unfilled portion of the position will be resolved through the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) process. Users are strongly advised to actively monitor and manage open positions during the final hour, as this period may be subject to heightened volatility and reduced liquidity. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contract(s) without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: Delisting of Futures contract Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Mark Price and Price Index Thank you for your support! articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist COIN-M RUNEUSD Perpetual Contract (2025-11-19)
articles.body_text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on COIN-M RUNEUSD Perpetual Contract at 2025-11-19 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract(s) starting from 2025-11-19 08:30 (UTC) . During the final hour proceeding the scheduled settlement time of a futures contract, the Futures Insurance Fund will not be utilised to support the liquidation process in respect of that futures contract. Any such liquidation triggered during the final hour will be executed as a single Immediate or Cancel order (“IOCO”), which will be offloaded into the market in one attempt. If, following the execution of the IOCO, the assets remaining available in the user's account are sufficient to meet the required Maintenance Margin (after accounting for realized losses and any applicable Liquidation Clearance Fee), the liquidation will cease. If the IOCO fails to fully reduce the position to a level that satisfies the Margin Maintenance requirements, any unfilled portion of the position will be resolved through the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) process. Users are strongly advised to actively monitor and manage open positions during the final hour, as this period may be subject to heightened volatility and reduced liquidity. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contract(s) without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: Delisting of Futures contract Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Mark Price and Price Index Thank you for your support! articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist COIN-M MANAUSD and EGLDUSD Perpetual Contracts (2025-11-13)
articles.body_text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on COIN-M MANAUSD and EGLDUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2025-11-13 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract(s) starting from 2025-11-13 08:30 (UTC) . During the final hour proceeding the scheduled settlement time of a futures contract, the Futures Insurance Fund will not be utilised to support the liquidation process in respect of that futures contract. Any such liquidation triggered during the final hour will be executed as a single Immediate or Cancel order (“IOCO”), which will be offloaded into the market in one attempt. If, following the execution of the IOCO, the assets remaining available in the user's account are sufficient to meet the required Maintenance Margin (after accounting for realized losses and any applicable Liquidation Clearance Fee), the liquidation will cease. If the IOCO fails to fully reduce the position to a level that satisfies the Margin Maintenance requirements, any unfilled portion of the position will be resolved through the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) process. Users are strongly advised to actively monitor and manage open positions during the final hour, as this period may be subject to heightened volatility and reduced liquidity. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contract(s) without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: Delisting of Futures contract Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Mark Price and Price Index Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-11-07

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist COIN-M GMTUSD and DOGSUSD Perpetual Contracts (2025-10-28)
articles.body_text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on COIN-M GMTUSD and DOGSUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2025-10-28 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract(s) starting from 2025-10-28 08:30 (UTC) . During the final hour proceeding the scheduled settlement time of a futures contract, the Futures Insurance Fund will not be utilised to support the liquidation process in respect of that futures contract. Any such liquidation triggered during the final hour will be executed as a single Immediate or Cancel order (“IOCO”), which will be offloaded into the market in one attempt. If, following the execution of the IOCO, the assets remaining available in the user's account are sufficient to meet the required Maintenance Margin (after accounting for realized losses and any applicable Liquidation Clearance Fee), the liquidation will cease. If the IOCO fails to fully reduce the position to a level that satisfies the Margin Maintenance requirements, any unfilled portion of the position will be resolved through the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) process. Users are strongly advised to actively monitor and manage open positions during the final hour, as this period may be subject to heightened volatility and reduced liquidity. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contract(s) without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: Delisting of Futures contract Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Mark Price and Price Index Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-10-23

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist USDⓈ-M HIFIUSDT and BAKEUSDT Perpetual Contracts (2025-10-03)
articles.body_text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on USDⓈ-M HIFIUSDT and BAKEUSDT perpetual contracts at 2025-10-03 09:00 (UTC). The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract(s) starting from 2025-10-03 08:30 (UTC) . During the final hour proceeding the scheduled settlement time of a futures contract, the Futures Insurance Fund will not be utilised to support the liquidation process in respect of that futures contract. Any such liquidation triggered during the final hour will be executed as a single Immediate or Cancel order (“IOCO”), which will be offloaded into the market in one attempt. If, following the execution of the IOCO, the assets remaining available in the user's account are sufficient to meet the required Maintenance Margin (after accounting for realized losses and any applicable Liquidation Clearance Fee), the liquidation will cease. If the IOCO fails to fully reduce the position to a level that satisfies the Margin Maintenance requirements, any unfilled portion of the position will be resolved through the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) process. Users are strongly advised to actively monitor and manage open positions during the final hour, as this period may be subject to heightened volatility and reduced liquidity. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contract(s) without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: Delisting of Futures contract Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures Contract Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contract Mark Price and Price Index Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-09-29

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist USDⓈ-M NEIROETHUSDT Perpetual Contract (2025-09-26)
articles.body_text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on USDⓈ-M NEIROETHUSDT perpetual contract at 2025-09-26 09:00 (UTC). The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract starting from 2025-09-26 08:30 (UTC) . During the final hour proceeding the scheduled settlement time of a futures contract, the Futures Insurance Fund will not be utilised to support the liquidation process in respect of that futures contract. Any such liquidation triggered during the final hour will be executed as a single Immediate or Cancel order (“IOCO”), which will be offloaded into the market in one attempt. If, following the execution of the IOCO, the assets remaining available in the user's account are sufficient to meet the required Maintenance Margin (after accounting for realized losses and any applicable Liquidation Clearance Fee), the liquidation will cease. If the IOCO fails to fully reduce the position to a level that satisfies the Margin Maintenance requirements, any unfilled portion of the position will be resolved through the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) process. Users are strongly advised to actively monitor and manage open positions during the final hour, as this period may be subject to heightened volatility and reduced liquidity. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contract without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: Delisting of Futures contract Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Mark Price and Price Index Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-09-22

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist USDⓈ-M BSWUSDT Perpetual Contract (2025-09-15)
articles.body_text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on USDⓈ-M BSWUSDT perpetual contract at 2025-09-15 09:00 (UTC). The contract will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract starting from 2025-09-15 08:30 (UTC) . During the final hour proceeding the scheduled settlement time of a futures contract, the Futures Insurance Fund will not be utilised to support the liquidation process in respect of that futures contract. Any such liquidation triggered during the final hour will be executed as a single Immediate or Cancel order (“IOCO”), which will be offloaded into the market in one attempt. If, following the execution of the IOCO, the assets remaining available in the user's account are sufficient to meet the required Maintenance Margin (after accounting for realized losses and any applicable Liquidation Clearance Fee), the liquidation will cease. If the IOCO fails to fully reduce the position to a level that satisfies the Margin Maintenance requirements, any unfilled portion of the position will be resolved through the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) process. Users are strongly advised to actively monitor and manage open positions during the final hour, as this period may be subject to heightened volatility and reduced liquidity. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contract without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: Delisting of Futures contract Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Mark Price and Price Index Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-09-10

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist USDⓈ-M DEFIUSDT and MEMEFI Perpetual Contracts (2025-08-11)
articles.body_text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on USDⓈ-M DEFIUSDT and MEMEFI perpetual contracts at 2025-08-11 09:00 (UTC). The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contracts starting from 2025-08-11 08:30 (UTC) . During the final hour proceeding the scheduled settlement time of a futures contract, the Futures Insurance Fund will not be utilised to support the liquidation process in respect of that futures contract. Any such liquidation triggered during the final hour will be executed as a single Immediate or Cancel order (“IOCO”), which will be offloaded into the market in one attempt. If, following the execution of the IOCO, the assets remaining available in the user's account are sufficient to meet the required Maintenance Margin (after accounting for realized losses and any applicable Liquidation Clearance Fee), the liquidation will cease. If the IOCO fails to fully reduce the position to a level that satisfies the Margin Maintenance requirements, any unfilled portion of the position will be resolved through the Auto-Deleveraging (ADL) process. Users are strongly advised to actively monitor and manage open positions during the final hour, as this period may be subject to heightened volatility and reduced liquidity. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contract without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information: Delisting of Futures contract Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures contract Mark Price and Price Index Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-08-06

Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will further postpone the delisting of the USDⓈ-M OMGUSDT Perpetual Contract to 2025-01-31 09:00 (UTC) . articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist USDⓈ-M MAVIAUSDT, OMGUSDT, and BONDUSDT Perpetual Contracts (2024-12-16)
articles.body_text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M MAVIAUSDT, OMGUSDT, and BONDUSDT USDⓈ-M perpetual contracts at 2024-12-16 09:00 (UTC). The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. Please Note:  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contracts starting from 2024-12-16 08:30 (UTC) . At 2024-12-16 09:00 (UTC) , Binance Funding Rate Arbitrage Bot will close all arbitrage strategies and conduct an automatic settlement on the MAVIAUSDT, OMGUSDT, and BONDUSDT symbols. The pairs will no longer be available for opening new arbitrage strategies upon delisting. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contracts without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates , such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information : Delisting of Futures Contracts Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Mark Price and Price Index Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2024-12-06

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of COIN-M KNCUSD, ICXUSD, XTZUSD, ROSEUSD and APEUSD Perpetual Contracts
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the COIN-M KNCUSD, ICXUSD and XTZUSD COIN-M perpetual contracts at 2024-05-20 09:00 (UTC) , and ROSEUSD and APEUSD COIN-M perpetual contracts at 2024-05-21 09:00 (UTC). The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the COIN-M KNCUSD, ICXUSD, XTZUSD, ROSEUSD and APEUSD perpetual contracts at 2024-05-10 10:30 (UTC) , as per the tables below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: COIN-M KNCUSD Perpetual Contract Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in KNC) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in KNC) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 11 - Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contracts starting from the following dates: 2024-05-20 08:30 (UTC) : KNCUSD, ICXUSD and XTZUSD COIN-M perpetual contracts 2024-05-21 08:30 (UTC) : ROSEUSD and APEUSD COIN-M perpetual contracts  In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contracts without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. All KNC, ICX, XTZ, ROSE and APE positive balances in CM Wallets under the Portfolio Margin account will be automatically transferred to Cross Margin Wallet after the settlement is complete. For those who do not have a Portfolio Margin account, the balances in CM Wallets will be transferred to Spot Wallet.  All KNC, ICX, XTZ, ROSE and APE negative balances in CM Wallets under the Portfolio Margin account will conduct an auto-repayment process after the settlement is complete. The conversion may take approximately 24 hours or longer. Binance will not be liable for any losses on new positions during this period that may incur as a result of the conversion of funds. Refer to this FAQ for more information. There may be discrepancies in the translated version of this original article in English. Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise. For More Information : Delisting of Futures Contracts Trading Rules of COIN-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of COIN-M Futures Contracts Mark Price and Price Index Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2024-05-10

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M IDEXUSDT, SLPUSDT, GLMRUSDT, MDTUSDT and AUDIOUSDT Perpetual Contracts
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M IDEXUSDT, SLPUSDT and GLMRUSDT USDⓈ-M perpetual contracts at 2024-05-15 09:00 (UTC) , and MDTUSDT and AUDIOUSDT USDⓈ-M perpetual contracts at 2024-05-16 09:00 (UTC). The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M IDEXUSDT, SLPUSDT, MDTUSDT and AUDIOUSDT perpetual contracts at 2024-05-08 10:30 (UTC) , as per the tables below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: USDⓈ-M IDEXUSDT, MDTUSDT Perpetual Contracts Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in USDT) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in USDT) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 16 - Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contracts starting from the following dates: 2024-05-15 08:30 (UTC) : IDEXUSDT, SLPUSDT and GLMRUSDT USDⓈ-M perpetual contracts 2024-05-16 08:30 (UTC) : MDTUSDT and AUDIOUSDT USDⓈ-M perpetual contracts  In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contracts without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M STPTUSDT, SNTUSDT, MBLUSDT, RADUSDT and CVXUSDT Perpetual Contracts
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M STPTUSDT, SNTUSDT and MBLUSDT USDⓈ-M perpetual contracts at 2024-05-13 09:00 (UTC) , and RADUSDT and CVXUSDT USDⓈ-M perpetual contracts at 2024-05-14 09:00 (UTC). The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M STPTUSDT, SNTUSDT, MBLUSDT, RADUSDT and CVXUSDT perpetual contracts at 2024-05-06 10:30 (UTC) , as per the tables below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: USDⓈ-M STPTUSDT Perpetual Contract Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in USDT) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in USDT) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 21 - Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contracts starting from the following dates: 2024-05-13 08:30 (UTC) : STPTUSDT, SNTUSDT and MBLUSDT USDⓈ-M perpetual contracts 2024-05-14 08:30 (UTC) : RADUSDT and CVXUSDT USDⓈ-M perpetual contracts  In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contracts without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M ANTUSDT, DGBUSDT and CTKUSDT Perpetual Contracts
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M ANTUSDT, DGBUSDT and CTKUSDT perpetual contracts at 2024-04-01 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M ANTUSDT, DGBUSDT and CTKUSDT perpetual contracts at 2024-03-25 10:30 (UTC) , as per the tables below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: USDⓈ-M ANTUSDT Perpetual Contract Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in USDT) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in USDT) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 21 - 50x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 1.50% 21x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 1.50% 11 - 20x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 11 - 20x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 10x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6 - 10x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 3,000,000 50.00% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 50.00% USDⓈ-M DGBUSDT and CTKUSDT Perpetual Contracts Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in USDT) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in USDT) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 11 - 20x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 11x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 9 - 10x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 8x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6 - 8x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 3,000,000 50.00% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 50.00% Please Note:  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contracts starting from 2024-04-01 08:30 (UTC) . In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contracts without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies in the translated version of this original article in English. Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise. For More Information : Delisting of Futures Contracts Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Mark Price and Price Index Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2024-03-25

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M FOOTBALLUSDT and BLUEBIRDUSDT Perpetual Contracts
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M FOOTBALLUSDT and BLUEBIRDUSDT perpetual contracts at 2024-03-26 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M FOOTBALLUSDT and BLUEBIRDUSDT perpetual contracts at 2024-03-19 10:30 (UTC) , as per the tables below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: USDⓈ-M FOOTBALLUSDT Perpetual Contract Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in USDT) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in USDT) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 11 - 20x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 11x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 9 - 10x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 8x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6 - 8x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,000,000 50.00% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 50.00% USDⓈ-M BLUEBIRDUSDT Perpetual Contract Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in USDT) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in USDT) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 11 - 20x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 1.00% 11x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 1.00% 9 - 10x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 9 - 10x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 8x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6 - 8x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,000,000 50.00% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 50.00% Please Note:  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contracts starting from 2024-03-26 08:30 (UTC) . In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned contracts without further announcement, including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. There may be discrepancies in the translated version of this original article in English. Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise. articles.title: Binance Margin & Binance Futures Will Delist BUSD
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians , Binance Margin and Binance Futures will be delisting BUSD in accordance with the following timelines. Margin: At 2023-12-01 06:00 (UTC) , Binance Margin will suspend BUSD/USDT isolated margin borrowing. At 2023-12-11 09:00 (UTC) , Binance Margin will close users’ positions, conduct an automatic settlement and cancel all pending orders on the BUSD/USDT and TUSD/BUSD cross margin pairs, as well as the BUSD/USDT isolated margin pair. If users have any outstanding Cross Margin or Isolated Margin loans, both the delisted assets and any other assets held in their Cross and Isolated Margin accounts may be sold to repay the outstanding liabilities. These pairs will then be removed from Cross Margin and Isolated Margin.  Please note that users will not be able to update their positions during the delisting process, and they are strongly advised to close their positions and/or transfer their assets from Margin Wallets to Spot Wallets prior to the cessation of margin trading at 2023-12-11 09:00 (UTC) . Binance Margin will not be responsible for any potential losses.  Portfolio Margin users are advised to transfer the tokens mentioned above out of their Margin Wallet to their Spot Wallet and to top up their margin balance before 2023-12-11 09:00 (UTC) where applicable. Users should monitor the Unified Maintenance Margin Ratio (Uni-MMR) closely to avoid any potential liquidation that may result from the removal of the tokens mentioned above from the Margin Wallet. All BUSD balances in Cross Margin Wallets under the Portfolio Margin account will be automatically converted to USDT from 2023-12-11 09:00 (UTC) . The conversion may take approximately 24 hours or longer. Binance Margin will not be liable for any losses on new positions during this period that may incur due to the conversion of funds. Refer to this FAQ for more information. Futures: Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M BTCBUSD, ETHBUSD, BNBBUSD and XRPBUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-11-24 14:00 (UTC) , as per the tables below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  BTCBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 51 - Prior to this time, the fee structure for BUSD-Margined Contracts applies to the ETHBTC Linear Perpetual Contract. Binance Futures will suspend trading for the aforementioned BUSD-Margined Perpetual Contracts on the following dates. Please note that users are allowed to close any existing positions after this time. At 2023-12-08 05:30 (UTC): USDⓈ-M BNBBUSD and XRPBUSD Perpetual Contracts At 2023-12-11 05:30 (UTC): USDⓈ-M BTCBUSD and ETHBUSD Perpetual Contracts Binance Futures will close all positions, conduct an automatic settlement and cancel all pending orders on the aforementioned BUSD-Margined Perpetual Contracts, and delist these contracts after the settlement is complete on the following dates: At 2023-12-08 06:00 (UTC): USDⓈ-M BNBBUSD and XRPBUSD Perpetual Contracts At 2023-12-11 06:00 (UTC): USDⓈ-M BTCBUSD and ETHBUSD Perpetual Contracts Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the respective delisting timings to avoid automatic settlement. Please refer to the delisting process of futures contracts for more details. In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the aforementioned BUSD-Margined Perpetual Contracts without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. Binance Futures will discontinue support for BUSD as a margin asset in the Multi-Assets Mode at 2023-12-11 10:00 (UTC) . BUSD transfers to USDⓈ-M Futures wallets will not be supported after 2023-12-11 10:00 (UTC) .   Binance Futures will automatically convert any remaining BUSD balances in USDⓈ-M Futures wallets to USDT at a 1:1 ratio starting from 2023-12-14 03:00 (UTC) . The conversion will take approximately 24 hours. Users are strongly encouraged to top up BUSD before 2023-12-11 10:00 (UTC) if they have a negative BUSD balance in their USDⓈ-M Futures wallets.  Please note that the conversion may not be reflected in the Transaction History. In addition, users are strongly advised not to add any new futures positions during the conversion period to avoid any potential losses. Binance will not be liable for any losses for new positions during this period that may incur due to the conversion of funds. Users may refer to this announcement for further information.  Note : Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-11-24

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M SOLBUSD Perpetual Contract
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M SOLBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-08-28 09:00 (UTC) . The contract will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M SOLBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-08-21 12:30 (UTC) , as per the table below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: SOLBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 21 - 25x 0 < Position ≤ 50,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 0 < Position ≤ 50,000 2.00% 11 - 20x 50,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 2.50% 7 - 8x 50,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 2.50% 6 - 10x 100,000 < Position ≤ 500,000 5.00% 6x 100,000 < Position ≤ 500,000 5.00% 4 - 5x 500,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 10.00% 4 - 5x 500,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 10.00% 3x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 2,000,000 15.00% 3x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 2,000,000 15.00% 2x 2,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,000,000 25.00% 2x 2,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,000,000 25.00% 1x 5,000,000 < Position ≤ 8,000,000 50.00% 1x 5,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,500,000 50.00% Please Note :  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract starting from 2023-08-28 08:30 (UTC) . In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M SOLBUSD Perpetual Contract without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. For More Information : Delisting of Futures Contracts Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Mark Price and Price Index Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-08-21

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M LTCBUSD and DOGEBUSD Perpetual Contracts
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M LTCBUSD and DOGEBUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-08-24 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M LTCBUSD and DOGEBUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-08-17 12:30 (UTC) , as per the tables below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: LTCBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 16 - 25x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 11 - 15x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 7 - 8x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 10x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 4x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 12.50% 3 - 4x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 12.50% 2x 1,500,000 < Position ≤ 3,000,000 25.00% 2x 1,500,000 < Position ≤ 3,000,000 25.00% 1x 3,000,000 < Position ≤ 8,000,000 50.00% 1x 3,000,000 < Position ≤ 3,200,000 50.00% DOGEBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 11 - 20x 0 < Position ≤ 100,000 2.50% 9 - 10x 0 < Position ≤ 100,000 2.50% 6 - 10x 100,000 < Position ≤ 500,000 5.00% 6 - 8x 100,000 < Position ≤ 500,000 5.00% 4 - 5x 500,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 10.00% 4 - 5x 500,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 10.00% 3x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 2,000,000 15.00% 3x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 2,000,000 15.00% 2x 2,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,000,000 25.00% 2x 2,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,000,000 25.00% 1x 5,000,000 < Position ≤ 8,000,000 50.00% 1x 5,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,200,000 50.00% Please Note :  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contracts starting from 2023-08-24 08:30 (UTC) . In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M LTCBUSD and DOGEBUSD Perpetual Contracts without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. For More Information : Delisting of Futures Contracts Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Mark Price and Price Index Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-08-17

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M ADABUSD and MATICBUSD Perpetual Contract
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M ADABUSD and MATICBUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-08-17 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M ADABUSD and MATICBUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-08-10 12:30 (UTC) , as per the tables below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M TRXBUSD and DODOBUSD Perpetual Contracts
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M TRXBUSD and DODOBUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-08-10 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M TRXBUSD and DODOBUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-08-04 06:00 (UTC) , as per the tables below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M APTBUSD and FTMBUSD Perpetual Contracts
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M APTBUSD and FTMBUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-08-03 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M APTBUSD and FTMBUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-07-27 14:00 (UTC) , as per the table below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: APTBUSD and FTMBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 16 - 25x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 11 - 15x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 7 - 8x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 10x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 4x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 12.50% 3 - 4x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 12.50% 2x 1,500,000 < Position ≤ 3,000,000 25.00% 2x 1,500,000 < Position ≤ 3,000,000 25.00% 1x 3,000,000 < Position ≤ 8,000,000 50.00% 1x 3,000,000 < Position ≤ 4,000,000 50.00% Please Note :  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contracts starting from 2023-08-03 08:30 (UTC) . In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M APTBUSD and FTMBUSD Perpetual Contracts without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. For More Information : Delisting of Futures Contracts Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Mark Price and Price Index Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-07-27
