articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M LDOBUSD and GALABUSD Perpetual Contracts
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M LDOBUSD and GALABUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-07-27 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M LDOBUSD and GALABUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-07-20 14:00 (UTC) , as per the table below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: LDOBUSD and GALABUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 11 - 20x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 7 - 8x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 8x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,000,000 50.00% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 2,000,000 50.00% Please Note :  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contracts starting from 2023-07-27 08:30 (UTC) . In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M LDOBUSD and GALABUSD Perpetual Contracts without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. For More Information : Delisting of Futures Contracts Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Mark Price and Price Index Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-07-20

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M AGIXBUSD Perpetual Contract
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M AGIXBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-07-20 09:00 (UTC) . The contract will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M AGIXBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-07-11 14:00 (UTC) , as per the table below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: AGIXBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 11 - 15x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 7 - 8x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 8x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,000,000 50.00% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 50.00% Please Note :  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract starting from 2023-07-20 08:30 (UTC) . In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M AGIXBUSD Perpetual Contract without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. For more information : Delisting of Futures Contracts Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Mark Price and Price Index Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-07-11

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M 1000LUNCBUSD Perpetual Contract
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M 1000LUNCBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-06-08 09:00 (UTC) . The contract will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M 1000LUNCBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-06-01 12:00 (UTC) , as per the table below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: 1000LUNCBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate Before Change Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate After Change 11 - 20x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 7 - 8x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 8x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,000,000 50.00% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 50.00% Please Note :  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract starting from 2023-06-08 08:30 (UTC) . In order to protect users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M 1000LUNCBUSD Perpetual Contract without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. For more information : Delisting of Futures Contracts Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Mark Price and Price Index Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-06-01 Trade on-the-go with Binance’s crypto trading app (iOS/Android) Find us on  Telegram Twitter Facebook Instagram Binance reserves the right in its sole discretion to amend or cancel this announcement at any time and for any reasons without prior notice. Risk Warning : Digital asset prices can be volatile. The value of your investment may go down or up and you may not get back the amount invested. You are solely responsible for your investment decisions and Binance is not liable for any losses you may incur. Futures trading, in particular, is subject to high market risk and price volatility. All of your margin balance may be liquidated in the event of adverse price movement. Past performance is not a reliable predictor of future performance. Before trading, you should make an independent assessment of the appropriateness of the transaction in light of your own objectives and circumstances, including the risks and potential benefits. Consult your own advisers, where appropriate. This information should not be construed as financial or investment advice. To learn more about how to protect yourself, visit our Responsible Trading page . For more information, see our Terms of Use and Risk Warning .

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M 1000SHIBBUSD Perpetual Contract
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M 1000SHIBBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-06-01 09:00 (UTC) . The contract will be delisted after the settlement is complete. articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M LINKBUSD Perpetual Contract
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M LINKBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-05-23 09:00 (UTC) . The contract will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M LINKBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-05-19 12:30 (UTC) , as per the table below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: LINKBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Before Change Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (Before Change) Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (After Change) 16 - 25x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 11 - 15x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 7 - 8x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 10x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 4x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 12.50% 3 - 4x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 12.50% 2x 1,500,000 < Position ≤ 3,000,000 25.00% 2x 1,500,000 < Position ≤ 3,000,000 25.00% 1x 3,000,000 < Position ≤ 8,000,000 50.00% 1x 3,000,000 < Position ≤ 4,000,000 50.00% Please Note :  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract starting from 2023-05-23 08:30 (UTC) . In order to protect the users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M LINKBUSD Perpetual Contract without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. For more information : Delisting of Futures Contracts Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Mark Price and Price Index Thanks for your support! You are solely responsible for your investment decisions and Binance is not liable for any losses you may incur. Futures trading, in particular, is subject to high market risk and price volatility. All of your margin balance may be liquidated in the event of adverse price movement. Past performance is not a reliable predictor of future performance. Before trading, you should make an independent assessment of the appropriateness of the transaction in light of your own objectives and circumstances, including the risks and potential benefits. Consult your own advisers, where appropriate. This information should not be construed as financial or investment advice. To learn more about how to protect yourself, visit our Responsible Trading page . For more information, see our Terms of Use and Risk Warning .

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M APEBUSD Perpetual Contract
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M APEBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-05-16 09:00 (UTC) . The contract will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M APEBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-05-12 12:30 (UTC) , as per the table below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: APEBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (Before Change) Leverage Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (After Change) 11 - 20x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 7 - 8x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 8x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,000,000 50.00% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 1,200,000 50.00% Please Note :  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract starting from 2023-05-16 08:30 (UTC) . In order to protect the users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M APEBUSD Perpetual Contract without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. For more information : Delisting of Futures Contracts Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Mark Price and Price Index Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-05-12 Trade on-the-go with Binance’s crypto trading app (iOS/Android) Find us on  Telegram Twitter Facebook Instagram Binance reserves the right in its sole discretion to amend or cancel this announcement at any time and for any reasons without prior notice. Risk Warning : Digital asset prices can be volatile. The value of your investment may go down or up and you may not get back the amount invested. You are solely responsible for your investment decisions and Binance is not liable for any losses you may incur. Futures trading, in particular, is subject to high market risk and price volatility. All of your margin balance may be liquidated in the event of adverse price movement. Past performance is not a reliable predictor of future performance. Before trading, you should make an independent assessment of the appropriateness of the transaction in light of your own objectives and circumstances, including the risks and potential benefits. Consult your own advisers, where appropriate. This information should not be construed as financial or investment advice. To learn more about how to protect yourself, visit our Responsible Trading page . For more information, see our Terms of Use and Risk Warning .

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M DOTBUSD Perpetual Contract
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M DOTBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-05-09 09:00 (UTC). . The contract will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M DOTBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-05-05 12:30 (UTC) , as per the table below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: DOTBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (Before Change) Leverage Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (After Change) 16 - 25x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 11 - 15x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 7 - 8x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 10x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 4x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 12.50% 3 - 4x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 12.50% 2x 1,500,000 < Position ≤ 3,000,000 25.00% 2x 1,500,000 < Position ≤ 3,000,000 25.00% 1x 3,000,000 < Position ≤ 8,000,000 50.00% 1x 3,000,000 < Position ≤ 4,000,000 50.00% Please Note :  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract starting from 2023-05-09 08:30 (UTC) . In order to protect the users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M DOTBUSD Perpetual Contract without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. For more information : Delisting of Futures Contracts Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Mark Price and Price Index Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-05-05 Trade on-the-go with Binance’s crypto trading app (iOS/Android) Find us on  Telegram Twitter Facebook Instagram Binance reserves the right in its sole discretion to amend or cancel this announcement at any time and for any reasons without prior notice. Risk Warning : Digital asset prices can be volatile. The value of your investment may go down or up and you may not get back the amount invested. You are solely responsible for your investment decisions and Binance is not liable for any losses you may incur. Futures trading, in particular, is subject to high market risk and price volatility. All of your margin balance may be liquidated in the event of adverse price movement. Past performance is not a reliable predictor of future performance. Before trading, you should make an independent assessment of the appropriateness of the transaction in light of your own objectives and circumstances, including the risks and potential benefits. Consult your own advisers, where appropriate. This information should not be construed as financial or investment advice. To learn more about how to protect yourself, visit our Responsible Trading page . For more information, see our Terms of Use and Risk Warning .

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M FILBUSD Perpetual Contract
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M FILBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-05-02 09:00 (UTC) . The contract will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M FILBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-04-28 12:30 (UTC) , as per the table below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: FILBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (Before Change) Leverage Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (After Change) 11 - 20x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 8x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 7x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 8x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,000,000 50.00% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 2,000,000 50.00% Please Note :  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract starting from 2023-05-02 08:30 (UTC) . In order to protect the users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M FILBUSD Perpetual Contract without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. For more information : Delisting of Futures Contracts Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Mark Price and Price Index Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-04-28 Trade on-the-go with Binance’s crypto trading app (iOS/Android) Find us on  Telegram Twitter Facebook Instagram Binance reserves the right in its sole discretion to amend or cancel this announcement at any time and for any reasons without prior notice. Risk Warning : Digital asset prices can be volatile. The value of your investment may go down or up and you may not get back the amount invested. You are solely responsible for your investment decisions and Binance is not liable for any losses you may incur. Futures trading, in particular, is subject to high market risk and price volatility. All of your margin balance may be liquidated in the event of adverse price movement. Past performance is not a reliable predictor of future performance. Before trading, you should make an independent assessment of the appropriateness of the transaction in light of your own objectives and circumstances, including the risks and potential benefits. Consult your own advisers, where appropriate. This information should not be construed as financial or investment advice. To learn more about how to protect yourself, visit our Responsible Trading page . For more information, see our Terms of Use and Risk Warning .

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M ETCBUSD Perpetual Contract
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M ETCBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-04-25 09:00 (UTC) . The contract will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M ETCBUSD Perpetual Contract at 2023-04-21 12:00 (UTC) , as per the table below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: ETCBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (Before Change) Leverage Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (After Change) 11 - 20x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 8x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 7x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 8x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,000,000 50.00% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 50.00% Please Note :  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contract starting from 2023-04-25 08:30 (UTC) . In order to protect the users and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M ETCBUSD Perpetual Contract without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. For more information : Delisting of Futures Contracts Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Mark Price and Price Index Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-04-21 Trade on-the-go with Binance’s crypto trading app (iOS/Android) Find us on  Telegram Twitter Facebook Instagram Binance reserves the right in its sole discretion to amend or cancel this announcement at any time and for any reasons without prior notice. Risk Warning : Digital asset prices can be volatile. The value of your investment may go down or up and you may not get back the amount invested. You are solely responsible for your investment decisions and Binance is not liable for any losses you may incur. Futures trading, in particular, is subject to high market risk and price volatility. All of your margin balance may be liquidated in the event of adverse price movement. Past performance is not a reliable predictor of future performance. Before trading, you should make an independent assessment of the appropriateness of the transaction in light of your own objectives and circumstances, including the risks and potential benefits. Consult your own advisers, where appropriate. This information should not be construed as financial or investment advice. To learn more about how to protect yourself, visit our Responsible Trading page . For more information, see our Terms of Use and Risk Warning .

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M GMTBUSD, NEARBUSD and AVAXBUSD Perpetual Contracts
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M GMTBUSD, NEARBUSD and AVAXBUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-04-18 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M GMTBUSD, NEARBUSD and AVAXBUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-04-14 15:00 (UTC) , as per the tables below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: GMTBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (Before Change) Leverage Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (After Change) 11 - Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contracts starting from 2023-04-18 08:30 (UTC) . In order to protect our customers and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M GMTBUSD, NEARBUSD and AVAXBUSD Perpetual Contracts without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M PHBBUSD, SANDBUSD and UNIBUSD Perpetual Contracts
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M PHBBUSD, SANDBUSD and UNIBUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-04-11 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M PHBBUSD, SANDBUSD and UNIBUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-04-06 11:30 (UTC) , as per the tables below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: PHBBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (Before Change) Leverage Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (After Change) 11x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 8x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 7x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 8x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,000,000 50.00% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 50.00% SANDBUSD and UNIBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (Before Change) Leverage Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (After Change) 11 - 20x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 8x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 7x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 8x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,000,000 50.00% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 50.00% Please Note :  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contracts starting from 2023-04-11 08:30 (UTC) . In order to protect our customers and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M PHBBUSD, SANDBUSD and UNIBUSD Perpetual Contracts without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. For more information : Delisting of Futures Contracts Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Mark Price and Price Index Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-04-06   Trade on-the-go with Binance’s crypto trading app (iOS/Android) Find us on  Telegram Twitter Facebook Instagram Binance reserves the right in its sole discretion to amend or cancel this announcement at any time and for any reasons without prior notice. Risk Warning : Digital asset prices can be volatile. The value of your investment may go down or up and you may not get back the amount invested. You are solely responsible for your investment decisions and Binance is not liable for any losses you may incur. Futures trading, in particular, is subject to high market risk and price volatility. All of your margin balance may be liquidated in the event of adverse price movement. Past performance is not a reliable predictor of future performance. Before trading, you should make an independent assessment of the appropriateness of the transaction in light of your own objectives and circumstances, including the risks and potential benefits. Consult your own advisers, where appropriate. This information should not be construed as financial or investment advice. To learn more about how to protect yourself, visit our Responsible Trading page . For more information, see our Terms of Use and Risk Warning .

articles.title: Binance Futures Will Delist and Update the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M AMBBUSD, LEVERBUSD and TLMBUSD Perpetual Contracts
articles.body_text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will close all positions and conduct an automatic settlement on the USDⓈ-M AMBBUSD, LEVERBUSD and TLMBUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-04-04 09:00 (UTC) . The contracts will be delisted after the settlement is complete. In addition, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage and margin tiers of the USDⓈ-M LEVERBUSD and TLMBUSD Perpetual Contracts at 2023-03-31 10:30 (UTC) , as per the tables below. Existing positions opened before the update will be affected . It is strongly advised to adjust the position and leverage prior to the adjustment in order to avoid any potential liquidation.  Updates to Leverage & Margin Tiers: LEVERBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (Before Change) Leverage Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (After Change) 8x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.30% 8x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.30% 7x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 7x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 2,000,000 50.00% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 50.00% TLMBUSD (USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts) Previous Leverage and Margin Tiers New Leverage and Margin Tiers Leverage Position Before Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (Before Change) Leverage After Change Position After Change (Notional Value in BUSD) Maintenance Margin Rate (After Change) 11 - 20x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 0 < Position ≤ 5,000 2.00% 9 - 10x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 7 - 8x 5,000 < Position ≤ 25,000 2.50% 6 - 8x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 6x 25,000 < Position ≤ 100,000 5.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 3 - 5x 100,000 < Position ≤ 250,000 10.00% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 2x 250,000 < Position ≤ 1,000,000 12.50% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 5,000,000 50.00% 1x 1,000,000 < Position ≤ 1,500,000 50.00% Please Note :  Users are advised to close any open positions prior to the delisting time to avoid automatic settlement. Users are not allowed to open new positions for the aforementioned contracts starting from 2023-04-04 08:30 (UTC) . In order to protect our customers and prevent potential risks in extremely volatile market conditions, Binance Futures may undertake additional protective measures toward the USDⓈ-M AMBBUSD, LEVERBUSD and TLMBUSD Perpetual Contracts without further announcement , including but not limited to adjusting the maximum leverage value, position value, and maintenance margin in each margin tier , updating funding rates such as the interest rate, premium and capped funding rate, changing the constituents of the price index, and using the Last Price Protected mechanism to update the Mark Price. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. For more information : Delisting of Futures Contracts Trading Rules of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Leverage and Margin of USDⓈ-M Futures Contracts Mark Price and Price Index Thanks for your support! All of your margin balance may be liquidated in the event of adverse price movement. Past performance is not a reliable predictor of future performance. Before trading, you should make an independent assessment of the appropriateness of the transaction in light of your own objectives and circumstances, including the risks and potential benefits. Consult your own advisers, where appropriate. This information should not be construed as financial or investment advice. To learn more about how to protect yourself, visit our Responsible Trading page . For more information, see our Terms of Use and Risk Warning .
